title: centunculus pumilus
intro: Centunculus pumilus, commonly known as Selfheal, is a low-growing perennial herb belonging to the mint family, Lamiaceae. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support immune function and wound healing. Selfheal is also known for its therapeutic actions, including its calming effects on the nervous system and its ability to soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Centunculus pumilus include flavonoids, such as tricetin and kaempferol, as well as phenolic acids and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
